data.description: Grigs are capable of rubbing their legs together like a cricket to create a surprisingly pleasant sound not unlike that of a tiny fiddle.  As a standard action, a grig can create a catchy tune that compels any creature within a 20-foot spread to dance and caper.  A creature can resist this compulsion by making a DC %1 Will save.  Creatures that fail are compelled to dance and shuffle their feet, and are effectively staggered as long as the grig continues to fiddle.  A grig can maintain this effect for up to 10 rounds per day by concentrating.  Once a creature makes a save against a grig's fiddle, it is immune to further fiddle effects from that grig for 24 hours.  This is a sonic mind-affecting effect.
data.name: Fiddle
